title: Ethical Risks in Deploying Large Language Models: An Evaluation of Medical Ethics Jailbreaking
findings: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion; its findings are focused on the vulnerability of LLMs to jailbreak attacks in the context of Chinese medical ethics.
